note: Weekly targets are the FY26/27 portfolio plan (week commencing 17 Aug). Portfolio bookings of 3,015 finished 23 percent below the 3,894 weekly target, up 0.8 percent week on week and 9.4 percent below last year. DSL is flagged not comparable: its target predates the rebrand, so 525 bookings against a 195 target is a target problem, not a performance one. Excluding DSL the portfolio is 2,490 against 3,699. Aqua Shard carries the gap: 1,127 against a 2,083 target and 1,861 last year, with users only 9 percent lower, so the loss sits in conversion and in paid search volume rather than in traffic. Hutong (+15.1 percent year on year) and DSL are the only venues ahead of last year; Regent St gave back last week's gain (-26 percent week on week). On YTD the portfolio is 5.0 percent behind cumulative target, and 16.5 percent behind excluding DSL. London is reported on covers as well as GA4 bookings, because GA4 only sees the website channel.
